fields.hubs.*.passage.gs4_listed: gs-4 flux.json configs[<gs4>].passage_hubs.{W,L} (TOP-16 by design; else ABSENT_TRUNCATED)
fields.hubs.*.passage.{W,L}: atlas kernel, gs-4's definition: P(roll visits the hub | it ends W / L), K.start('standing','me'); direct hitting solve
fields.hubs.*.q_mass: atlas kernel: K.qprocess() mu summed over the hub's 4 transient states (== gs-3 hub_stationary_mass, gs-5 mu_time)
fields.hubs.*.seat_advantage_top: derived from gs-2 rows: q_bar(top) - q_bar(bottom) (Prop D: = 2 q_bar - 1 under the symmetric rule)
fields.hubs.*.status: atlas kernel: both role-nodes in K.reachable; UNREACHABLE_FROM_STANDING = zero Q-process mass (== gs-5 not_evaluable)
fields.hubs.*.tempo_E_plies.<SEAT>: gs-2 scalars.json states[<gs2>].rows[<hub>/<seat>].{M,T}[E_plies], (M+T)/2: expected plies to the finish
fields.hubs.*.territory_tv: gs-3 geometry.json cases[<gs3>].clusterings.exit_tv.clusters (medoid id; label = the cell's accepted reading)
fields.role_nodes.*.coherence: gs-2 scalars.json coherence[<gs2>].disagreements[] (flagged) else not flagged
fields.role_nodes.*.passage: atlas kernel (gs-4 definition, role-node = both turns) + gs-4 passage_roles TOP-15
fields.role_nodes.*.phase_side: gs-1 phase side of the role-node's hub
fields.role_nodes.*.q_bar / seat_advantage: derived from gs-2 rows: (M+T)/2; q_bar(r) - q_bar(flip r)
